summary: Iter-42 retest of the two iter-41 backend bugs — BOTH VERIFIED FIXED. (1) MarketMeri extraction: fresh run 08d9e3e5-f378-41b0-b04d-ec199d9c207c on source 89cf6ddd finished status='success' with cards_seen=1257, cards_accepted=769 (listings_seen=769, matches_created=769), 62/70 pages_visited had cards_accepted>0 — the .listing-wrapper-grid selector fix works. (2) Accounting invariant now holds at run-level AND per-page level: cs=1257 == ca=769 + cr=488; sum(rejection_reasons)=294+69+125=488==cr; sum(pages_visited[*].cards_seen)=1257==cs; same equality for accepted/rejected. Detail-page math holds: attempted=769 == succeeded=769 + failed=0, and attempted>=accepted (769>=769). Legacy Hausples/other pre-fix runs still parse (diagnostics kept as-is, UI does not crash). Frontend smoke on /admin/market/sources confirmed: MarketMeri RunRow expanded shows all 8 counter cards (1257/769/488/125/70/769/769/0), 3 rejection badges with correct data-testid (rejection-no_numeric_price=294, rejection-no_url_in_card=69, rejection-duplicate_source_id_within_run=125), pages_visited sub-table lists all 70 rows (>>11 minimum), and MarketMeri real-estate URLs (real-estate/apartments, real-estate/land, real-estate/office, etc.) show cards_accepted>0. Regression: /health, /sources, /runs, /summary, /collectors, /scheduler still 200; POST /admin/market/scheduler/pause toggles both directions; POST collect on TREL Seed Generator returns success with pages_visited==[] and cards_seen==0 per contract; _id never leaks in any /api/admin/market/* response. Backend pytest: 13/13 PASSED (was 11 passed + 1 xfail pre-fix). xfail flipped to hard-assert in test_acceptance_math_holds and a new class TestMarketMeriCardExtractionFix::test_marketmeri_extracts_cards asserts the selector fix — both green.
